name: alpaca-issue-tracker
description: A lightweight issue tracker built entirely inside WordPress, designed for developers and agencies managing client projects.
author: Rareview®

scripts.zip: rm -f alpaca-issue-tracker.zip && npm run build && zip -r alpaca-issue-tracker.zip . -x '.*' '*/.*' '*.git*' '*.github/*' '*.DS_Store' '*node_modules*' 'tests/*' 'tests/**' 'skills/*' 'skills/**' 'vendor/autoload.php' 'vendor/bin/*' 'vendor/antecedent/*' 'vendor/brain/*' 'vendor/composer/*' 'vendor/dealerdirect/*' 'vendor/doctrine/*' 'vendor/hamcrest/*' 'vendor/mockery/*' 'vendor/myclabs/*' 'vendor/nikic/*' 'vendor/phar-io/*' 'vendor/phpcompatibility/*' 'vendor/phpcsstandards/*' 'vendor/phpunit/*' 'vendor/sebastian/*' 'vendor/squizlabs/*' 'vendor/theseer/*' 'vendor/wp-coding-standards/*' '.build/*' '.build/**' '.distignore' '.wordpress-org/*' '.wordpress-org/**' 'documentation/*' 'documentation/**' 'docs/*' 'docs/**' 'playground/*' 'playground/**' 'src/*' 'scripts/*' 'scripts/**' '*.parcel-cache*' '*.cache*' '*package*.json' '*composer.*' '*.xml' 'phpunit.xml.dist' '.*rc.json' 'AGENTS.md' 'README.md' 'alpaca-issue-tracker.zip' 'dist/*.map' '*.backup'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:styles && npm run lint:php && npm run lint:md
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:php && npm run format:md
scripts.fix: npm run fix:js && npm run fix:styles && npm run fix:php && npm run format:md
scripts.clb: npm run clear && npm run lint && npm run build
